# Utility room: agreed layout

Agreed on 2 March. Nothing has changed since.

Single wall run along the north wall, 2.4 m long, left to right:

- Washing machine and dryer stacked in one tall housing, 600 mm wide, at the left end. The housing has two doors.
- Two base units, 600 mm wide each, in the middle. Each has one door. One worktop runs over both.
- A Belfast sink, 600 mm wide, at the right end, with one mixer tap.
- One wall cupboard, 600 mm wide, above the worktop. It has one door.
- Every door gets one bar handle.
